trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies first
Finish with A Long Road (100% completion)
The platinum is awarded automatically
trophies.guide: The platinum itself asks for nothing extra: it is awarded the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Plan the whole run backwards from the gold A Long Road, because the 100% completion checklist absorbs most of this list on the way, and treat this trophy as the receipt for everything else in this guide.

trophies.guide: A pure story trophy: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this unlocks in the first minutes of the game simply by playing. It cannot be missed, and it is a good early moment to start the habits that pay off later — manual saves at chapter boundaries and scanning new vehicles as you meet them.

There is no mission replay, so PowerPyx advises keeping a save at the start and end of every chapter.

Work the checklist region by region in free-roam

trophies.guide: The long gold. The 100% checklist only appears after the story, and PowerPyx stresses it is far more forgiving than its name: roughly 60% of everything — 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges — with robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests required in full. PowerPyx rates it the hardest trophy on the list purely for the hours it takes (about 100 hours of cleanup after a 60-80 hour story).

The counter climbs fastest when you treat stunt spots as detours during normal travel instead of one endgame grind. Note the 100% checklist plans for 300 stunts, so a platinum run should keep going past the trophy's 250.

trophies.guide: Try each type of activity at least once — nine activity types, per KeenGamer's count. Nothing here needs skill or completion, just a first attempt at each: a race, a drone race, a fishing challenge, an arcade game, a shooting range and the rest as they unlock. Sampling new icons as they appear during the story clears this almost for free.

Settle into one range first to learn how its scoring rewards accuracy and speed, then sweep the rest.
